Reduce Heat Through Windows in Phoenix — Window Film Solutions

Why Phoenix Windows Let In So Much Heat

Phoenix's solar intensity is among the highest in North America. Standard double-pane glass blocks very little infrared radiation — the heat you feel when standing near a window. In Phoenix's 115°F summers, unprotected south and west-facing glass can raise interior temperatures by 15–20°F and force HVAC systems to run continuously. Window film targets the infrared spectrum directly.

How Window Film Reduces Heat in Phoenix Homes

Nano-ceramic window film rejects up to 84% of solar heat through infrared blocking technology. Unlike tinted glass or standard dyed film, ceramic film works by absorbing and reflecting infrared radiation at the molecular level — not by darkening the glass. Interior rooms stay bright while heat stays out.

Most Phoenix homeowners report 10–15°F reduction in room temperature near treated windows within days of installation.
